title: Kin_Island
lead_summary:
Kin Island, also known as Three Island, is the biggest town in Sevii Islands, and can be accessed from the South by Brine Road (East of the Old Shipwreck) and from the North by the Bond Bridge.
Bebe is in the Pokémon Center and will give the one of the Sinnoh starters.
Jasmine is on vacation with some family at Kin Island, but went North with her nephew and some friends.
If the player saw of caught both Kyogre and Groudon, the elderly man in the North-Eastern house will arrange with his son to escort the player to the Sky Pillar in the Harbour.
There is a fisherman on the shore who will tell you where it is raining around the Sevii Islands if you are looking for Feebas.
